import sys
from itertools import permutations

def min_cost_to_complete_tasks():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    A = list(map(int, input_data.split()))
    
    min_cost = float('inf')
    
    # Generate all permutations of the tasks
    for perm in permutations(A):
        cost = 0
        # Calculate the cost for the current permutation
        for i in range(1, len(perm)):
            cost += abs(perm[i] - perm[i - 1])
        # Update the minimum cost found
        min_cost = min(min_cost, cost)
    
    print(min_cost)
